# Tracker Update

Use this packet to draft one native tracker comment or status note. Replace every placeholder and report only observed evidence. Show the drafted comment and any status move to the operator with the issue they target, together with the other drafts for that issue, and write them only after approval unless standing permission covers them, as the project-management skill's Draft Tracker Writes rule describes. Write the comment for people, as the project-management skill's record-writing reference describes: one to three plain lines first, with no headings, and leave out any part with nothing to say. When a person needs to act, the summary says so; the next-step line only adds detail. The native reference and status intent route the update; they are never written into the comment. Check results and command output go in the pull request, naming the commit they ran on; only work with no pull request carries them here, after a divider in collapsed agent notes with any other detail only agents need.

When relevant, the summary names the operator journey now possible, the evidence names the real use and safety proof behind it, and the next step names the learning sought or the breadth still deferred.
